answer: An agent marketplace requires each identity to lock a fixed bond for 30 days before receiving a daily quota of paid jobs. Whether agents sell pulse readings, shale surveys, or inlet forecasts, each extra identity needs its own bond; splitting one balance across aliases earns no extra quota. An attacker seeking 1,000 times the access must immobilize 1,000 bonds for the full term, paying the financing cost even if every alias behaves well.
